scheme_name: Subsidy for Developing Business Premises for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Disability of at least 40% is required
For persons with mental retardation, the minimum age is reduced to 14 years
The land for the business premises must be the applicant's own or leased on a long‑term lease of more than 20 years from a government agency
The lease period must be at least 20 years on the date of application
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹3 lakh are provided to persons with disabilities to develop business premises on their own land and start self‑employment activities.
